### CONJECTURAL

- `c-conditional-expander-theorem` — [EG for 2-connected bounded-degree δ≥3 expanders (conditional)](../kb/claims/c-conditional-expander-theorem.md) · CONJECTURAL · claim · active · 2026-11-17  
  Every sufficiently large 2-connected α-expander with 3 ≤ δ ≤ Δ(G) ≤ Δ contains cycles of every even length in a linear range, in particular a cycle whose length is a power of two; and cycles of all residues mod every odd k (answering the bounded-degree case of Martinsson–Steiner's question).

### SKETCH

- `c-handoff-saturated-triangle-bound` — [8t < n for saturated triangle gadgets in bridgeless cubic dyadic-free graphs](../kb/claims/c-handoff-saturated-triangle-bound.md) · SKETCH · claim · active · 2026-11-17  
  If a bridgeless cubic graph of order n with no dyadic cycle contains t disjoint saturated T-gadgets, then 8t < n. (Contract the gadgets; a perfect matching of the bridgeless cubic base gives a 2-factor; the weighted window theorem forces a dyadic cycle once half the vertices are marked.)
